text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Vietnamese press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-- Prime Minister Vo Van Kiet appreciates the work of the news media but says it is also necessary to criticise and take timely action against reports which distort government policy.
-- Vietnam's first geothermal power plant is expected to be in operation by the end of next year.
-- The government has delayed submission to the National Assembly of new laws on the legal status of foreign banks.
-- A French businessman in Ho Chi Minh City has been arrested and accused of having sex with at least two boys under the age of 16.
-- Twenty one foreign investment projects with total capital of $461 million were licensed between January 1 and 24.
-- Vietnam has estimated its monthly trade deficit at $420 million in January.
-- More than $11.8 million will be spent for the restoration of the dyke system protecting Hanoi city.
